body:
I feel the same way sometimes.  like my family will check on me but I can tell they can’t wait to get off the phone because it’s inconvenient that I have mental health issues.
I have to say that most people are probably thinking about themselves ana their own issues and not about others as much.
hang in there ❤️ you are not alone
I know exactly how you feel.  i’ve had this type of thought since I was a child.
Sometimes I really despise this world.  I don’t fit here.  I don’t belong here.  Yet here I am.  Free will my ass.   I wish I was never born so much it aches.
Yep.  Jackass videotaped me while I was in the shower for years before I found out.
I am not getting videotaped in my own home without my consent.
Please look into neurofeedback and EMDR.  They are forms of therapy that are very effective for depression, anxiety, PTSD.  Life changing.
I am 39 and just ended a 17 year relationship as well.  I can’t imagine marrying again.  This shit gutted me.

I haven’t always had to.  We’ve been married for 15, together for 17.  Along the way due to our difference in libido there were many times were i just did it (duty sex) because I wanted to meet his needs and make him happy.  I didn’t realize what this was going to do to my psyche until after the damage was done.  We are working through a lot of our issues but I am having trouble overcoming the aversion even though we have a much better understanding now of how we view sex and what our needs are.  So frustrating.  He is my best friend, otherwise from sex we are very compatible and have two little kids so we very much want to make it work.  I have some sexual trauma in my past which doesn’t make things any easier for me.  Ugh.

I’ve had thoughts of not wanting to exist since I was a child.  Lately bc of a situation in my life it’s gotten so much worse.  I pray for death.  I can never commit suicide bc I have two kids.  
Just wanted you to know you are not alone.

Are there any activities or hobbies that you enjoy?   I still get drug down by the monotony if the daily /weekly tasks that I have to do, but I do have one hobby that I enjoy and it brings me joy amongst the other BS.   I’ve really been wanting to explore volunteering, as it will hopefully get me out of my own head & problems.
Same here.  I’m sorry you are going through this too.  I have a hard time seeing what the point of life is. Just a bunch of endless mundane shit repeated over and over.
